rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for saying that food is delicious.

example.english: This fish ball noodle soup is really yummy.
example.jyutping: ne1 wun2 jyu4 daan2 fan2 zan1 hai6 hou2 sik6

rows.note: Use this for delicious food when you want to emphasize its good taste or flavor.

example.english: The curry you made is really yummy; the spice flavor really comes through.
example.traditional: 你整嘅咖喱真係好味，香料味好出。
example.jyutping: nei5 zing2 ge3 gaa3 lei1 zan1 hai6 hou2 mei6 hoeng1 liu2 mei6 hou2 ceot1
